challengeFindings.title: Under CI a file's own localLimit(N) returns 6N, because vitest.setup.ts deletes CI before the test file evaluates it, so a CI hang in machine-lock.integration.test.ts waits 60 minutes, not 10

branches.test.ts keeps a bare 60s limit through const GIT_TIMEOUT = 60_000 on 16 describe blocks, and the no-bare-limit guard cannot see a named constant, so those suites stay at 60s locally while every other file gets 6x

Scaling an already-large file limit by 6 lets one hung local test hold the machine-wide tests lock for up to an hour (localLimit(600_000) = 3,600,000 ms, localLimit(240_000) = 24 min), past the 1200s lock wait other agents use, so their runs give up with exit 81

With CI=false exported, bats takes the 30s CI branch ([ -n "${CI:-}" ]) while Vitest and node --test take the 180s local limit (limitFactor matches only true / 1), and the bats parity test reads only the else branch, so the split drifts unseen
